title: Publish/rollback + snapshot management
description: Publish flow with confirmation + impact summary. Rollback to snapshot. Snapshot list with side-by-side comparison.
definitionOfDone: Publish button with confirmation dialog showing impact summary
Rollback to any snapshot with confirmation
Snapshot list: version, published at, published by, rule count
Side-by-side comparison between any two snapshots

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/policy/PublishControls.tsx: Publish button at top of policy page. On click: opens confirmation dialog showing impact summary (rules changed count, rules added/removed). Calls usePublishPolicy() mutation. Success shows version number and timestamp. Rollback section: select from usePolicySnapshots() list. Each snapshot: version number, published at, published by, rule count. Rollback button with confirmation calls useRollbackPolicy(snapshotId).
implementationPlan.note: Created PublishControls with publish button + confirmation showing impact, snapshot list with rollback buttons + confirmation. Added usePolicySnapshot hook and rules field to PolicySnapshot type.

implementationPlan.description: Create dashboard/src/components/policy/SnapshotComparison.tsx: Side-by-side comparison of two policy snapshots. Select two snapshots from dropdowns. Left panel: snapshot A rules, right panel: snapshot B rules. Diff highlighting: added rules (green background), removed rules (red background), changed rules (yellow background). Uses the same RuleCard rendering for visual consistency.
implementationPlan.note: Created SnapshotComparison with dual dropdown selectors, diff algorithm (added/removed/changed/unchanged), side-by-side rule cards with color-coded highlights (green/red/yellow), diff summary counts.

implementationPlan.description: Integrate PublishControls into PolicyPage header and SnapshotComparison as 'Snapshots' tab.
implementationPlan.note: Integrated PublishControls and SnapshotComparison into snapshots tab. PublishControls gets bundleId/version/ruleCount from active bundle.
tsc --noEmit passes clean. Fixed TS2339 by removing unreachable catch-all branch (all Tab values now handled).
